report_comment.text: ETV6 encodes an ETS-family transcriptional repressor with an amino-terminal oligomerization domain. NTRK2 encodes TRKB, a neurotrophin receptor tyrosine kinase. ETV6::NTRK2 was identified in secondary refractory AML and retained the full NTRK2 kinase domain. Expression of the fusion supported cytokine-independent growth of Ba/F3 and 32D cells, demonstrating transforming activity in these experimental hematopoietic models. A patient with refractory secondary AML and ETV6::NTRK2 achieved a partial remission with larotrectinib, followed by clinical relapse after 10–12 weeks. The patient also harbored ETV6::MECOM and other alterations, and the response differed between clones. This is case-level clinical evidence.
